t: The Antifragile Intelligence: Scheduling as a Commitment Device
s: This article explores AI scheduling as a commitment device, reframing it as an antifragile system that learns from its environment and leverages psychological principles of consistency and self-hacking. It also delves into the philosophical debate on AI creativity versus advanced analysis, using analogies to Bell's Theorem and AlphaGo's Move 37.
